artifact.explanation:
Preparing a faithful runnable reference. No rejection reason applies: the tutorial's two figshare inputs are publicly available with upstream provider checksums, and the whole analysis runs offline once those files are staged. The baseline executes unchanged except (a) two input-staging edits that replace the pooch DOI registry/download with identical, checksum-verified local files under /inputs, and (b) one appended export block. No algorithm, parameter, filtering threshold, label, seed, annotation or execution order is altered; all source plotting calls remain intact (rendered under Agg, figures are not captured).

Scientific coverage (8 branches -> 7 endpoint artifacts). (1) dataset loading and per-sample composition (the printed value_counts, sample identities); (2) per-cell QC metrics and cell/gene filtering (violin/scatter underlying data); (3) Scrublet doublet scores and calls per cell; (4) median-normalization with log1p plus 2000 highly-variable genes by sample; (5) PCA (explained variance ratios) and the neighborhood graph; (6) UMAP embedding plus Leiden clustering at default and 0.02/0.50/2.00 resolutions; (7) curated marker-gene dotplot values (leiden_res_0.02 and leiden_res_0.50) and the manual cell_type_lvl1 annotation; (8) per-cluster Wilcoxon DE results including the displayed cluster-7 top-5 table. adata_final.h5ad holds the complete final state (per-cell/per-gene annotations, X, layers["counts"], X_pca, X_umap, neighbor graph, rank_genes_groups) and serves several branches; cell_metadata.csv (obs + UMAP coordinates) and gene_metadata.csv (var) expose per-cell/per-gene results, which also cover the values underlying the violin, scatter, UMAP, PCA-color and QC-reassessment figures; sample_composition.csv records the printed per-sample counts and pre/post-filter sizes; pca_variance_ratio.csv holds the values plotted by sc.pl.pca_variance_ratio; marker_expression.csv holds the two dotplots' underlying values; deg_cluster7_top5.csv holds the displayed cluster-7 DE table.

Export rationale: the two marker dotplots are quantified with scanpy's public aggregator sc.get.aggregate applied to the same X matrix and cluster labels the plots use (dot color = cluster-wise mean expression of log-normalized X; dot size = fraction of expressing cells, zero expression threshold; standard_scale="var" is display-only scaling). This additional computation is needed because the DotPlot object leaves no per-cluster values in adata; equivalence is checkable at the validation stage, e.g. by direct per-cluster recomputation from adata (mean over the cluster's cells; nonzero counts divided by cluster size) and, optionally, against a DotPlot re-rendered with return_fig=True. The cluster-7 table is serialized through the same public accessor the source uses (sc.get.rank_genes_groups_df(adata, group="7").head(5)), which reads the run's stored uns["rank_genes_groups"] without re-running the test. The early printed value_counts are exported from the retained per-sample AnnData objects (adatas[sample_id].n_obs), which reproduce the printed numbers exactly. No capture edits were used: no standalone call returns a required result (print returns None; the displayed DataFrame expressions are not standalone statements).

Runtime within 600 s, memory within 8 GiB, install feasibility on CPython 3.13, h5ad serialization details, and the presence of cluster "7" are not asserted by source inspection alone; the reference execution must establish them (see unresolved assumptions).
artifact.environment_rationale: Base image is python:3.13.13-slim-bookworm (CPython 3.13, Debian 12). All declared and transitive scientific packages (numpy, scipy, scikit-learn, numba/llvmlite, umap-learn, pynndescent, h5py, matplotlib, python-igraph, legacy-api) are expected to resolve as binary manylinux wheels for CPython 3.13, so no Debian packages or build tooling are required and system_packages is empty; uv lock/uv sync confirm this at setup. scanpy: the source notebook (revision 8c1463d5, docs-era) uses leiden flavor="igraph" (scanpy >= 1.10), sc.get.rank_genes_groups_df, and references sc.get.aggregate in its narrative; scanpy 1.11 is the first line with official CPython 3.13 support needed for the base image, hence ">=1.11,<1.12" (upper bound guards against future API drift). The source declares no versions, so these bounds are reconstructed from the APIs used; the exact versions are fixed by the controller's uv lock and preserved inventory. igraph is declared explicitly because flavor="igraph" requires python-igraph (leidenalg is not used by any leiden call in this script). pooch is declared because the unchanged script imports it even though the DOI retrieval is replaced by staged local files. anndata (ad.concat, direct import) and pandas (exported CSV tables) are declared because they are used directly. Dependencies needed by sc.pp.neighbors/sc.tl.umap (umap-learn, pynndescent, numba), sc.pp.scrublet (scikit-learn), h5py, matplotlib and the rest arrive transitively through scanpy's own pins rather than being invented here. Input staging uses only the Python standard library (urllib, hashlib, json) available in the controller-created venv; MPLBACKEND=Agg is set by the controller so all sc.pl.* calls run non-interactively. The offline reference run reads only /inputs/s1d1_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5 and /inputs/s1d3_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5; no network access is needed at execution time.
excluded_outputs: Rendered matplotlib figures from sc.pl.violin, sc.pl.scatter, sc.pl.highly_variable_genes, sc.pl.pca, sc.pl.pca_variance_ratio, sc.pl.umap (all variants), sc.pl.dotplot and sc.pl.rank_genes_groups_dotplot: per the planning rules the underlying values and identifiers are exported instead (cell_metadata.csv, gene_metadata.csv, pca_variance_ratio.csv, marker_expression.csv, plus X_pca/X_umap/variance_ratio and obs colors in adata_final.h5ad). The source plotting calls are left intact.

The duplicate second sc.pl.umap call showing leiden_res_0.02/0.50/2.00 (identical repeated plot in the source) and other repeated displays: identical values already exported once through cell_metadata.csv.

Full per-cluster DE tables (all tested genes for every leiden_res_0.50 cluster) as separate CSVs: the complete results are natively preserved in adata_final.h5ad uns['rank_genes_groups'] (names/scores/pvals/pvals_adj/logfoldchanges/pts per group); only the explicitly displayed cluster-7 top-5 table is additionally serialized as deg_cluster7_top5.csv.

Pre-filter (unfiltered) count matrices and the exact cells/genes removed by QC filtering: not a tutorial endpoint; the filtered raw counts actually analysed are preserved in adata_final.h5ad layers['counts'], and the filtering effect is summarized by sample_composition.csv.
Neighborhood-graph edge lists as text: the connectivities/distances matrices are preserved in adata_final.h5ad obsp, and their consequence (cluster assignments) is exported in cell_metadata.csv.
unresolved_assumptions: The provider MD5 and byte-size checksums from the figshare metadata (s1d1: a99285913ea3f3d22600d3d2f8a88e34, 22848647 bytes; s1d3: 825f7f7578e3dc0b8955f5a97a402338, 20432298 bytes) are assumed to match the files served by the ndownloader URLs; the staging script verifies this and aborts setup on mismatch (an upstream input-identity failure to report, not to work around).

Total runtime of the unchanged analysis plus exports within the 600 s reference limit (scrublet doublet simulation including per-batch runs, pynndescent neighbors including JIT compilation, UMAP, Wilcoxon rank_genes_groups, h5ad write) is unmeasured; the reference execution must establish it. A resource overrun would be a resource-limits rejection reason, not permission to simplify the science.

Peak memory within 8 GiB (the two per-sample AnnData objects retained by the source plus the concatenated object with the counts layer, scrublet temporaries, and per-group dense slicing inside the Wilcoxon test) is unmeasured; execution must establish it.

Dependency resolution on CPython 3.13 (scanpy 1.11.x with numba/llvmlite/umap-learn/pynndescent wheels) is expected to succeed via uv lock/uv sync but must be confirmed at install time; an incompatible resolution is reported, not silently relaxed.

The unchanged source assumes a cluster labeled '7' exists in leiden_res_0.50 for sc.get.rank_genes_groups_df(adata, group='7'); if the reference run's clustering does not produce it, the source itself fails and no faithful preparation can repair that without changing the analysis.

h5ad serialization of the scanpy-added fields (scrublet obs columns, the rank_genes_groups structured arrays in uns, categorical identifiers, layers) is expected to work but is only established at execution.
Marker genes are assumed to survive gene filtering (min_cells=3); the export omits any absent gene and the source dotplot calls themselves determine behaviour if one were missing.

Reproducibility of neighbors/UMAP/igraph-Leiden given the default seeds is expected but not guaranteed across library builds or CPU counts; the reference run defines the recorded values and the controller fixes the thread limits.

artifacts.description: Per-sample composition of the concatenated dataset: raw cell and gene counts of each staged sample (sample_id -> n_cells, n_genes), the per-sample cell counts that the source prints via adata.obs['sample'].value_counts(), the total concatenated size, and the filtered sizes after sc.pp.filter_cells(min_genes=100) and sc.pp.filter_genes(min_cells=3), which quantify effective gene-space reduction.
artifacts.source_evidence: samples dict, sc.read_10x_h5 loop over s1d1/s1d3, sc.concat(adatas, label='sample'), print(adata.obs['sample'].value_counts(), sc.pp.filter_cells(adata, min_genes=100), sc.pp.filter_genes(adata, min_cells=3).

artifacts.description: Full final AnnData state of the analysis. Per-cell: sample, QC metrics (n_genes_by_counts, total_counts, pct_counts_mt/ribo/hb with log1p variants, retained metrics outside HVGs), scrublet doublet_score and predicted_doublet, all leiden cluster assignments, cell_type_lvl1 annotations. Per-gene: mt/ribo/hb flags, highly_variable annotations with dispersions/nb/cv means, n_cells. X: log-median-normalized data; layers: counts with the raw filtered counts; obsm: X_pca and X_umap; varm: PC loadings; obsp: connectivities/distances; uns: log1p, hvg, pca params, neighbors params and distances, leiden params, rank_genes_groups names/scores/pvals/pvals_adj/logfoldchanges/pts per cluster (full Wilcoxon DE results).
artifacts.source_evidence: Whole tutorial: adata is carried through QC, doublet detection, normalization, HVG selection, PCA, neighbors, UMAP, leiden clustering and rank_genes_groups; adata.layers['counts'] = adata.X.copy() before normalization.

artifacts.description: Per-cell result table (one row per cellular barcode): obs fields (sample, all QC metrics, doublet_score, predicted_doublet, leiden, leiden_res_0.02/0.50/2.00, cell_type_lvl1) joined with the cells' PC scores (X_pca) and UMAP coordinates (X_umap). These are the data underlying the QC violin plots, joint scatter plot, PCA coordinate-colored plots, UMAP samples visualization, QC re-assessment plots and all leiden-resolution UMAP displays.

branches.name: Dataset loading and per-sample composition
branches.scientific_result: The concatenated bone-marrow dataset with sample identities (s1d1, s1d3, matching the NeurIPS 2021 study) and the per-sample cell counts printed by the source (value_counts), together with the filter cells (<100 genes) and genes (<3 cells) effect on the data.
branches.source_evidence: samples dict with s1d1/s1d3, sc.concat(adatas, label='sample'), print(adata.obs['sample'].value_counts()), sc.pp.filter_cells(adata, min_genes=100), sc.pp.filter_genes(adata, min_cells=3).

branches.name: Quality control metrics and filtering
branches.scientific_result: Per-cell QC metrics (n_genes_by_counts, total_counts, pct_counts_mt/ribo/hb and their log1p variants) and per-gene QC metrics (n_cells) with mt/ribo/hb population assignments, including the effects of the min_genes=100 cell filter and min_cells=3 gene filter; these are the values that the violin and scatter plots display.
branches.source_evidence: adata.var['mt'/'ribo'/'hb'] flag assignment, sc.pp.calculate_qc_metrics(adata, qc_vars=['mt','ribo','hb'], inplace=True, log1p=True), sc.pl.violin(...['n_genes_by_counts','total_counts','pct_counts_mt']), sc.pl.scatter(adata, 'total_counts','n_genes_by_counts', color='pct_counts_mt'), filter_cells/filter_genes.

branches.name: Doublet detection (Scrublet)
branches.scientific_result: Per-cell doublet scores and predicted doublet calls from scrublet run batch-wise on the sample key, which also satisfy the later re-analysis condition; a diagnostic simulated-doublet PCA scores diagnostic showing the observed vs simulated transcriptome separation.
branches.source_evidence: sc.pp.scrublet(adata, batch_key='sample') adding 'doublet_score' and 'predicted_doublet' to obs along with uns['scrublet'] and obsm['X_doublet_pca']; re-assessed later in sc.pl.umap(color=['leiden','predicted_doublet','doublet_score']).

branches.name: Normalization and feature selection
branches.scientific_result: Normalized expression matrices: raw counts preserved in a counts layer, plus median-count normalization and log1p transform (the X matrix used throughout the remaining analysis) and the 2000 highly variable genes selected with the Seurat flavor pooled across samples, with their dispersion-based ranking statistics.
branches.source_evidence: adata.layers['counts'] = adata.X.copy(), sc.pp.normalize_total(adata) (median depth), sc.pp.log1p(adata), sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(adata, n_top_genes=2000, batch_key='sample'), sc.pl.highly_variable_genes(adata).

branches.name: Dimensionality reduction: PCA
branches.scientific_result: Principal component analysis of the HVG-normalized data including PC scores per cell, the first 50 PCs' variance ratio and cumulative explained variance (log scale as plotted) used to choose the number of neighbors-computing PCs, and the PC loadings per gene.
branches.source_evidence: sc.tl.pca(adata), sc.pl.pca_variance_ratio(adata, n_pcs=50, log=True), sc.pl.pca(adata, color=['sample','sample','pct_counts_mt','pct_counts_mt'], dimensions=[(0,1),(2,3),(0,1),(2,3)], ncols=2, size=2), sc.pp.neighbors(adata).

branches.name: Neighbor graph, UMAP and Leiden clustering
branches.scientific_result: The kNN graph with its connectivities and distance matrices, the UMAP 2D embedding of cells driven by that graph and neighbors along with the sample identity layout showing the low batch effect, and the four Leiden partitions (default resolution and resolutions 0.02/0.50/2.00, igraph flavor, fixed preparation) equivalently partitioning the cell set.
branches.source_evidence: sc.pp.neighbors(adata), sc.tl.umap(adata), sc.pl.umap(adata, color='sample', size=2), sc.tl.leiden(adata, flavor='igraph', n_iterations=2), the for res in [0.02, 0.5, 2.0] loop adding leiden_res_0.02/leiden_res_0.50/leiden_res_2.00, and the umap 观察 calls color=['leiden'] and ['leiden_res_0.02','leiden_res_0.50','leiden_res_2.00'].

branches.name: Marker gene expression and manual cell-type annotation
branches.scientific_result: Mark-gene average expression and fraction of expressing cells for the 16 curated cell-type marker sets, as displayed in the two standard_scale='var' dotplots on the clusterings at resolution 0.02 (coarse lineages) and 0.50 (fine clusters), and the derived cell_type_lvl1 labels assigning Leiden 0/1/2/3/4 to Lymphocytes, Monocytes, B Cells, Erythroid, Erythroid.
branches.source_evidence: marker_genes dict (CD14+ Mono ... pDC), sc.pl.dotplot(adata, marker_genes, groupby='leiden_res_0.02', standard_scale='var'), adata.obs['cell_type_lvl1'] = adata.obs['leiden_res_0.02'].map({'0': 'Lymphocytes','1': 'Monocytes','2': 'B Cells','3': 'Erythroid','4': 'Erythroid'}), sc.pl.dotplot(adata, marker_genes, groupby='leiden_res_0.50', standard_scale='var').

branches.name: Differentially expressed genes per cluster (Wilcoxon)
branches.scientific_result: Wilcoxon rank-sum tests for each cluster vs rest on leiden_res_0.50, with per-cluster gene scores and p-values, focus on the top 5 markers for Cluster 7 (NK cells, e.g. NKG7, GNLY) that the tutorial inspects, visualized on the UMAP and in the rank-genes-groups dotplot.
branches.source_evidence: sc.tl.rank_genes_groups(adata, groupby='leiden_res_0.50', method='wilcoxon'), sc.pl.rank_genes_groups_dotplot(adata, groupby='leiden_res_0.50', standard_scale='var', n_genes=5), dc_cluster_genes = sc.get.rank_genes_groups_df(adata, group='7').head(5)['names'], sc.pl.umap(adata, color=[*dc_cluster_genes,'leiden_res_0.50'], legend_loc='on data', frameon=False, ncols=3).
